units.source_text: 务请体谅父母长年切望之苦心。”

en.t: Please understand the painful devotion with which my parents have long yearned for this.

units.source_text: 说时全身战栗，但亦不失体统。

en.t: As she spoke, her whole body trembled, yet she did not lose her composure.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“你那住惯荒浦之人，岂能如我这般寂寥。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "You, who are used to living on a desolate shore, could hardly feel as lonely as I do."
